referenceFunction.generalComment: Disposal of a ground heat exchanger for an office building with a specific air flow rate of 4.0 m3/h per m2 heated gross floor area. The reference value of the inventory is 1 m2 heated gross floor area. The inventory is based on a short ground heat exchanger with a specific duct lenght of 0.067m per m3 nominal air flow. The inventory includes a ground heat exchanger with 200mm diameter and a lenght of 0.267m/m2. The data represents a ground heat exchanger made of polyethylene. It includes the excavating needed and a bedding layer made of poor concrete.; UUID: 9997100c-5ee6-434d-9c98-d99d9d3ec196
